body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> TomTom announces its connected portable navigation device 'GO 740 LIVE' at 2009 CES.

The GO 740 LIVE provides the industry's best routing and helps drivers take control of their daily drive via automatic delivery of helpful features including: real-time traffic information, TomTom Fuel Price Service, Local Search powered by Google, TomTom Weather, QuickGPSfix and TomTom Buddies
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
